gRPC test server with REPL commands to kill streams or restart the server.

# Purpose
This file defines a local gRPC server that implements the `BlockEngineValidator` and `AuthService` APIs. The `ServiceHandle` type exposes handlers for packet and bundle subscription streams, block builder fee data, auth challenge generation, token generation, and access token refresh. The stream handlers send repeated test data through `tokio::mpsc` channels and stop when a shared `broadcast` kill signal arrives. The auth handlers return fixed challenge and token values, with token expiry set to 60 seconds from the current time.

The file also contains the program entry point and a small command line control loop. `main` starts the gRPC server on `127.0.0.1:50051` in a separate thread, then runs a REPL on the current thread with `rustyline`. The REPL accepts commands such as `help`, `kill-streams`, `kill-server`, and `exit`, which let an operator stop active streams, restart the server, or end the process. The `proto` submodules use `tonic::include_proto!` to load the generated protobuf service and message types used by the server.
